name: Sibanye Stillwater Limited
source: Yahoo Finance | CRON r16 (2026-10-12): the H1 2026 column was already collected and stored in SSW__income.json for this security but never reached the JSE board, because the listing symbol is SSW.JO and the panel resolves .JO first. The same column is now published here, unchanged, so the newest period renders. Original per-cell provenance is in SSW__income.json. | CRON 2026-10-13: H1 2026 column (six months ended 30 June 2026) taken from Sibanye-Stillwater's own condensed consolidated interim income statement in the Operating and financial results booklet for the six months ended 30 June 2026, page 20 (SA rand column, figures in millions, so x1000000 here). Printed lines: Revenue 89 977, Cost of sales (60 453), Amortisation and depreciation (4 219), Gross profit 29 524, Interest income 772, Finance expense (2 264), Share-based payment expenses 119, Gain on financial instruments 58, Gain on foreign exchange differences 63, Share of results of equity-accounted investees after tax 1 641, Other costs (2 185), Other income 324, Gain on disposal of property plant and equipment 51, Impairments (18), Restructuring costs (153), Transaction and project costs (150), Profit before royalties carbon tax and tax 27 782, Royalties (1 668), Carbon tax (2), Profit before tax 26 112, Mining and income tax (7 305), Profit for the period 18 807, of which owners of Sibanye-Stillwater 17 745 and non-controlling interests 1 062, Basic earnings per share 627 cents. Ties checked against the printed statement: Revenue 89 977 less cost of sales 60 453 equals the printed gross profit 29 524; the operating lines from gross profit down to profit before royalties sum exactly to the printed 27 782; 27 782 less royalties 1 668 and carbon tax 2 equals the printed profit before tax 26 112; 26 112 less tax 7 305 equals the printed profit for the period 18 807. Net Profit is the owners-attributable line 17 745 because that is this file's convention in every older column (the FY2025 value equals H1 2025 owners 3 591 plus H2 2025 owners 1 580) and it is the line the printed basic EPS is struck on; the 1 062 non-controlling interest is the difference against the 18 807 total. Net Finance Costs is the printed finance expense 2 264 less the printed interest income 772. rows.label: Net Profit
rows.source: stockanalysis.com income statement (secondary data provider), blank cells only, calibrated to this row own stored values and checked against this file own printed rows

gapFill.method: blank cells filled from stockanalysis.com only where the source reproduced the same row already stored values within 1.5 percent AND the filled value tied to this file own printed rows (gross profit identity, net profit identity) within 2 percent
